name: popsicle
headline: ICO Marketing Automation Airdrop: Token Campaigns
short_description: A marketing automation skill for ICO airdrop campaigns, providing modular components for managing members, sessions, daemons, and data grids in token distribution workflows.
author: tedster0629

sections.overview:
The ico-marketing-automation-airdrop skill is a structured toolkit designed to support marketing automation for Initial Coin Offering (ICO) airdrop campaigns. The repository is organized into modular directories covering core functional areas such as member management, session handling, background daemons, data grid processing, password resets, and code generators. These components work together to support the operational workflows commonly required when running token airdrop campaigns. Blockchain projects and crypto marketing teams looking to automate participant management and airdrop distribution processes may find this skill relevant to their toolchain.
Automating participant enrollment and member management for ICO airdrop campaigns
Running background daemon processes to handle airdrop distribution tasks
Managing session and authentication flows for airdrop platform users
Generating and processing data grids of airdrop recipients
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/tedster0629/ico-marketing-automation-airdrop`
sections.usage:
```
Create a detailed airdrop campaign plan for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Include target audience, token distribution strategy, marketing channels, and expected outcomes. Ensure the plan is aligned with [COMPANY]'s overall ICO marketing strategy.
```
Copy

```
# Airdrop Campaign Plan for GreenTech ICO
```
